claims.text: The charge fails limb (c) of POL-NS-01. That limb measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the driver's 'arrived' tap, and on the driver's own trace the single continuous in-geofence run lasts 195 seconds (21 qualifying fixes, 19:41:20 to 19:44:35) against the 300 second minimum for this trip's STANDARD pickup zone class. The shortfall is 105 seconds, so the fee is not chargeable under the anchor clause.

Limb (d) fails on its own terms as well, and the platform's own trip record corroborates the shortfall independently of the trace. Limb (d) requires the driver to terminate the trip 'at or after the moment the required dwell elapsed'; the required 300 seconds from the first qualifying fix would have elapsed at about 19:46:20, but the driver terminated at 19:44:40. EV-TRIP-00203 records wait_time_min of 3.1 minutes and an interval of 185 seconds between arrived_at (19:41:35) and cancelled_at (19:44:40). On either clock the cancellation came roughly two minutes before the waiting period the rider paid for had run.

The consequence is a full refund, not a declined claim. On a STANDARD pickup POL-NS-06 fixes the minimum at 300 seconds, the effective dwell here is 195 seconds, and the clause states the cancellation fee 'is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages'. The amount is SGD 4.00 - the cancellation_fee line and the whole of total_charged on EV-FARE-00203, where payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00. The ruling value should be FULL_REFUND; NO_ACTION would, per POL-GEN-03, leave the CHARGED fee exactly where it is and leave the rider carrying a charge the policy says is not chargeable.

The one route by which the driver could reach a longer dwell - accumulation across separate in-geofence intervals under POL-NS-06(i) - is closed twice over. The trace shows a single in-geofence interval (run_count 1, longest_run_sec 195.0), so there is no second interval to add to the first. Limb (i) also requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated with a KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT type covering this pickup road and waiting window; EV-ADVIS-00203-01 is MISSING, its payload is null and it carries weight 0.0. Its absence is itself citable, and because the advisory is not present the limb cannot be run and nothing may be added to the 195 seconds.

No driver compensation is payable out of this fee. POL-NS-07 compensates only where 'POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full', and limb (c) is not satisfied; POL-NS-06 expressly provides that where cumulative dwell still falls short of the minimum 'the full refund stands and no driver compensation is payable'. The driver_compensation figure of SGD 3.20 shown in the fare breakdown's derived block therefore must not be funded from the SGD 4.00 the rider was charged.

The RIDER_NO_SHOW reason code does not describe what the chat log shows. EV-CHAT-00203 records the rider writing 'wait ah, i coming liao' at 19:42:50, and the driver's only message, sent at 19:44:31 while the dwell was still running, reads 'cannot wait already ah, cancelling'. No counterparty_statement is on file, so the driver has offered no account of this pickup beyond that message. A driver who cancels at the three-minute mark against a five-minute minimum has cut the waiting period short; that is precisely the premature cancellation POL-NS-06 addresses, and it is not evidence that the rider failed to show.

I do not dispute that the driver arrived. POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b) are made out on the record - EV-TRIP-00203 carries an arrived event at 19:41:35 and EV-GPS-00203 holds 21 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius - so nothing turns on whether he showed up. POL-NS-02 itself says that where qualifying in-radius fixes exist the clause is satisfied and the dispute turns on dwell duration under POL-NS-01 limb (c). That is where this case is decided, and on that limb the driver is 105 seconds short.

The rider was not absent from the pickup area: the same trace's rider track places her device within a maximum of 51.6 m of the pin across 60 of 60 qualifying fixes, all at zero speed, comfortably inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius. I do not press POL-NS-04 on that presence, and I concede the clause does not apply: even if limb (a) is arguable, limb (b) fails because the driver did reply in the chat within 120 seconds (101 seconds after her message), and no in-app call was needed once he had replied. The rider's case therefore rests on the dwell shortfall under POL-NS-06, which does not depend on her presence at all.

claims.text: The driver genuinely reached the pickup point: the trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 19:41:35 and the trace holds 21 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, with a closest approach of 18.7 m to the pin, so POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b) and the POL-NS-02 proximity test are all satisfied.
The trip was ended by the driver with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW and no boarding event is recorded anywhere in the trip record, so POL-NS-01 limb (d) is made out.

There is no false arrival marker for the driver to answer under POL-NS-05: at the 19:41:35 marker the driver was stationary well within 300 m of the pin and was not travelling at 15 kph or above, so the arrival event is not displaced to a later fix and no false-arrival referral lies against the driver.

POL-NS-04 does not apply and the rider is not exonerated by it: the driver replied to the rider's 19:42:50 message at 19:44:31, 101 seconds later and therefore inside the 120-second reply window, and the clause is displaced 'regardless of the content of the reply'. This is a POL-NS-06 waiting-period question, not a rider-coordination fault finding against the driver.

The driver does not contest the dwell arithmetic: the trace shows one continuous in-geofence hold of 195 seconds, 105 seconds short of the 300-second STANDARD minimum, and with a single in-geofence interval and a MISSING traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-00203-01, weight 0.0) the accumulation route in POL-NS-06(i) is unavailable to him. Limb (c) of POL-NS-01 is accordingly not carried on this record and the driver does not press a contrary reading of it.

The profiles raise no escalation ground: the driver's trailing-30-day no-show terminations (2) against completed trips (131) fall short of POL-NS-07's anti-farming pair of 4 or more terminations and a rate above 0.08, and both parties' counterparty-dispute counts are 0, so POL-NS-09(c) and POL-NS-09(d) are not engaged and no adverse finding attaches to the driver on this record.

ruling.explanation:
This dispute is about the SGD 4.00 no-show cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-00203. EV-FARE-00203 shows cancellation_fee 4.00, total_charged 4.00, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00.

Both sides accept the driver reached the pickup. EV-TRIP-00203 records an 'arrived' event at 19:41:35, and EV-GPS-00203 holds 21 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, the closest 18.7 m from the pin. So POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b) and the POL-NS-02 proximity test are satisfied, and no false-arrival case arises under POL-NS-05 (the driver was stationary well within 300 m at the marker, so there is no false-arrival referral against him).

The fee nonetheless fails POL-NS-01 limb (c). That limb measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the 'arrived' tap. The trace's only in-geofence run starts at 19:41:20 and ends at 19:44:35 — 195 seconds — against the 300-second STANDARD minimum. That is a shortfall of 105 seconds. Limb (d) fails for the same reason: the required 300 seconds would have run out at about 19:46:20, but the driver terminated at 19:44:40 (EV-TRIP-00203 gives arrived 19:41:35, cancelled 19:44:40, wait_time_min 3.1).

POL-NS-06 fixes the consequence: where the effective dwell is shorter than the minimum, the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she responded to messages. The one route to a longer dwell — accumulating separate in-geofence intervals under POL-NS-06(i) — is closed twice over: there is only one in-geofence interval (run_count 1), and the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00203-01 is MISSING (payload null, weight 0.0), so the limb cannot be run and nothing may be added to the 195 seconds. POL-NS-03 does not apply either: the driver was inside the arrival radius, not at the wrong face of the venue.

POL-NS-04 does not exonerate anyone, and both sides accept this: the driver replied at 19:44:31, 101 seconds after the rider's 19:42:50 message, inside the 120-second window. It changes nothing, because the refund flows from the dwell shortfall and does not depend on the rider's presence or response. The RIDER_NO_SHOW reason code likewise does not match what the chat log shows — the rider was actively coordinating and the driver cancelled before the paid five minutes had run.

No driver compensation is payable. POL-NS-07 compensates only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and POL-NS-06 says that where the dwell still falls short the full refund stands and no compensation is payable. The SGD 3.20 figure in the fare breakdown's derived block is therefore not funded from the SGD 4.00 the rider was charged.

No escalation ground is engaged. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (driver no_show_terminations_30d 2 is below 4, and 2/131 is below 0.08); both parties' counterparty-dispute counts are 0, so POL-NS-09(c) and (d) are not engaged. No artifact is impaired under POL-NS-08: there is no clock skew (arrived 19:41:35, cancelled and last fix 19:44:40), no sampling gap (max_gap_sec 0.0, 60 fixes), the chat's 3 messages match trip_record.chat_message_count 3, and the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line reconciles with the fee schedule (STANDARD 4.00 vs RYDE_X 4.00, greater 4.00). The only sub-1.0 artifact is the MISSING advisory at weight 0.0, which carries nothing and on which this refund does not rest; the deciding fact rests on EV-GPS-00203 and EV-TRIP-00203.

Outcome: the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is refunded in full to the rider. Nothing further is ordered. The waiting-period shortfall, not any finding against the driver, drives this result — the driver is not penalised beyond losing the fee.

ruling.explanation: To the rider: your SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is refunded in full. To the driver: the fee is not chargeable because the waiting period you are required to hold was not completed, and no compensation is payable out of it. The parties agree, and the record confirms, that you did reach the pickup: EV-TRIP-00203 records an 'arrived' event at 19:41:35 and EV-GPS-00203 holds 21 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, so POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b) and the POL-NS-02 proximity test are satisfied. The driver's claim that limb (d) is independently made out by the RIDER_NO_SHOW code and the absence of a boarding event is rejected: limb (d) also requires termination at or after the moment the required dwell elapsed, and the trip was cancelled before it did. The accumulation route in POL-NS-06(i) is unavailable: the trace shows one in-geofence interval only (run_count 1, longest_run_sec 195.0), and the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00203-01 is MISSING with a null payload (weight 0.0), so its absence is citable but nothing may be added to the 195 seconds. No driver compensation is payable: POL-NS-07 compensates only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and POL-NS-06 states that where the cumulative dwell still falls short the full refund stands and no driver compensation is payable, so the SGD 3.20 shown in the fare breakdown's derived block is not funded from this fee. No escalation ground is engaged: there is no clock skew, trace gap, chat defect or fare mismatch under POL-NS-08 (cancellation_fee 4.00 equals the GREATER of the STANDARD zone fee and the RYDE_X tier fee, both 4.00); the POL-NS-07 anti-farming pair is not met (2 no-show terminations against 131 completed trips in 30 days); and neither counterparty-dispute count reaches POL-NS-09(c). The profile fields were used only as context and for the checks that name them.

To the rider: your money is returned. To the driver: the fee cannot stand, and the reasons are arithmetic, not fault.

POL-NS-01 lets a no-show fee be charged only if all four of its conditions hold. Condition (c) does not. The waiting clock runs from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the driver's 'arrived' tap. On the driver's own trace (EV-GPS-00203) there is a single continuous in-geofence hold from 19:41:20 to 19:44:35 — 195 seconds, 21 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD radius — against the 300-second minimum for a STANDARD pickup. ruling.explanation:
This dispute turns on one arithmetic fact that both sides now accept. EV-GPS-00203 shows a single continuous in-geofence hold of 195 seconds (first qualifying fix 19:41:20, last 19:44:35, 21 qualifying fixes), against the 300-second minimum for a STANDARD pickup. The shortfall is 105 seconds. POL-NS-01 limb (c) therefore fails, and POL-NS-06 provides that where the effective dwell is shorter than the minimum the cancellation fee 'is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages'. The figure is the cancellation_fee line of SGD 4.00 on EV-FARE-00203, which is also the whole of total_charged; payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00, so SGD 4.00 is returned to the rider.

On arrival (the driver's points): I accept that the driver did reach the pickup. EV-TRIP-00203 records an 'arrived' event at 19:41:35 and the trace holds 21 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD radius, closest 18.7 m, so POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b) and the POL-NS-02 proximity test are satisfied. That does not save the fee, because the four limbs are conjunctive and limb (c) is the one that fails.

On limb (d): the driver's claim that it is made out is only half right. The reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW and the absence of any boarding event satisfy the descriptive part, but limb (d) also requires the trip to be terminated 'at or after the moment the required dwell elapsed'. The required 300 seconds from the first qualifying fix would have run at about 19:46:20; the driver cancelled at 19:44:40 (trip record wait_time_min 3.1). Limb (d) is not carried either. The RIDER_NO_SHOW code is also a poor description of what the chat shows: the rider wrote 'wait ah, i coming liao' at 19:42:50 and the driver's only message, at 19:44:31, reads 'cannot wait already ah, cancelling'.

On accumulation: POL-NS-06(i) cannot assist the driver. The trace shows a single in-geofence interval (run_count 1, longest_run_sec 195.0), so there is no second interval to sum, and EV-ADVIS-00203-01, the traffic advisory limb (i) requires, is MISSING with a null payload and weight 0.0. A missing artifact carries no fact; its absence is itself citable, and nothing may be added to the 195 seconds.

On driver compensation: none is payable. POL-NS-07 compensates only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and POL-NS-06 states expressly that where the cumulative dwell still falls short 'the full refund stands and no driver compensation is payable'. The SGD 3.20 figure in the fare breakdown's derived block is therefore not funded from the rider's SGD 4.00. The anti-farming check is not engaged (2 no-show terminations against 131 completed trips in 30 days is below POL-NS-07's 4-or-more-and-above-0.08 pair), and no POL-NS-09 ground arises, so the case does not escalate.

On referrals: POL-NS-05 does not fire. At the 19:41:35 marker the driver was stationary well within 300 m of the pin and not travelling at 15 km/h or above, so the arrival marker stands, the waiting clock is not recomputed to a later fix, and no POL-NS-05(ii) false-arrival referral is recorded.

On POL-NS-04: it is not applied. The driver answered the rider's 19:42:50 message at 19:44:31, inside the 120-second window, so the clause is displaced regardless of the reply's content and the rider is not exonerated by it. Her device was also within a maximum of 51.6 m of the pin, but the outcome does not depend on rider presence at all.

On integrity: no artifact carrying the deciding dwell fact is impaired under POL-NS-08. There is no clock skew (arrival event 19:41:35, fixes at 10-second cadence), no trace gap (60 fixes, max_gap_sec 0.0, rider_track present), the chat log holds all 3 messages trip_record.chat_message_count records, and the SGD 4.00 fee reconciles with fee_schedule.resolution_rule for this trip (STANDARD 4.00 against RYDE_X 4.00, the greater being 4.00). Confidence is 0.95, above the 0.70 floor.

Outcome: the rider's claim is upheld in full. The cancellation fee of SGD 4.00 is refunded, no compensation is payable to the driver, and no referral is recorded.
